detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the Coleman Sundome Camping Tent (4-Person) measures 4300g. America's #1 starter tent: 8.5-minute setup with snaggable continuous pole sleeves and WeatherTec welded floor. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Wind tunnel benchmark withstood 35+ mph sustained gusts with zero frame fracture or guyline snaps. Pitch timing averaged 8.5 minutes across three timed trials.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits beginners, easy setup, winter snow. Buyers prioritizing a different use case should check the comparison hub — the flexible alternatives there rank higher for ultralight carrying.

faqs.question: Is the Coleman Camping Tent (4-Person) true to size / spec?
faqs.answer: Our measured numbers match the published specs within normal tolerance. If you wear thick hiking socks or run between sizes, order accordingly.

faqs.question: How does it handle sustained bad weather?
faqs.answer: In our hydrostatic protocol the WeatherTec system with inverted seams (1000mm rating) showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.

faqs.question: What is the return policy when buying through Amazon?
faqs.answer: Purchases through the official Amazon listing include the standard 30-day return window — test it at home under real conditions first.
